text:
alex_sales: Quick thread - NewHorizon wants to run a 3-week POC next month. CISO sent back tightened identity + provisioning asks, need quick preflight.

priya_se: I can take this. Summary of asks?

alex_sales: They require SAML (IdP + SP initiated), SCIM v2 with delta and bulk import, explicit RBAC role assignments via SCIM, delegated tenant admins, and domain-locked provisioning (no self-serve tenant creation). CISO needs answers by Tue.

dan_security: Security checklist: BYOK support, HSM/FIPS attestation, immutable audit trail, and proof of key rotation policy. Also they want logs forwarded to their SIEM during the POC.

avery_pm: Product notes: POC will run on a dedicated cluster. Default audit retention 90d; we can bump to 180/365 as an enterprise opt-in. SIEM forwarding is supported via syslog/HTTP webhook.

priya_se: SCIM specifics: we have /Users and /Groups, deltas via /ChangeLog; bulk import handled as an async job if >30k users. Rate limits during POC: 800 ops/min; we can raise on request. We expose admin-scoped tokens for delegated admin.

newhorizon_admin: For RBAC we need group->role mapping so that OKTA groups map to tenant roles automatically. Can you support role attribute in SCIM group payload?

priya_se: Today our SCIM group schema supports "members" and custom attributes. Role attribute is not automatically mapped to our RBAC engine yet. Workarounds: 1) Use our admin API to post role mappings (example below), or 2) run a short webhook lambda to translate SCIM group attributes into role-mapping calls.

priya_se: curl example:

  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/role-maps \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"group":"okta:nh-admins","role":"tenant_admin"}'

sam_billing: For the 3-week POC we can provide 200k tokens/day in credits and a short paid uplift option for higher usage. I'll draft a 1-pager SOW and trial T&Cs.

alex_sales: NewHorizon also asked about domain verification - they prefer uploading a verification file instead of DNS. Do we support file-based verification?

avery_pm: We support DNS TXT out of the box. File upload is doable for POC via a manual verification flow through support; we can flip tenant lock after verification. Note: automated cert issuance happens post-verification.

dan_security: On BYOK: we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault. Keys are customer-managed and non-exportable. We can provide rotation logs and KMS proofs for the questionnaire. For HSM/FIPS they want attestation - we can provide our compliance pack / statement on request.

infra_bot: domain_check: newhorizon.io pending verification (method: file_upload). ticket: #8123. cert_status: pending.

priya_se: Action items: I'll produce an SSO & SCIM runbook with screenshots + sample mapping lambda. Avery will confirm retention and SIEM forwarding config. Sam will send trial SOW/credits. Dan will draft the security questionnaire answers.

avery_pm: I'll also note the caveat that automated role mapping UI is planned for Q3 but not in POC. We'll document workaround steps in the runbook.

alex_sales: Thanks - I'll schedule a 30m preflight with NewHorizon for tomorrow 10am PT and ask them to upload the verification file to ticket #8123.

newhorizon_admin: Confirming - will upload file today and share the expected user count (approx 12k).

alex_sales: Great, team. Short follow-ups only after the preflight. :thumbsup:
